calibration.title: Denser rigid-body search: recovery versus ranking

anchor.what: Independent transform reconstruction and DockQ fixtures validate execution; CPU outputs anchor identical GPU settings before dense quality evaluation.
anchor.tolerance: Exact input/settings/grid/count equality; exact ranked rotation/translation identity required, including rank1 and cutoff membership. Tie mismatch fails this strict gate. Independently reconstruct documented transforms and compare coordinates within eps_xyz; derive eps_xyz from serialization/rounding analysis. Require abs(score_CPU-score_GPU) <= atol + rtol*max(abs(score_CPU),abs(score_GPU)); derive atol/rtol from pinned FFT precision/error analysis plus nonstudy synthetic fixtures, never fresh four-case differences. Require each paired DockQ difference <= eps_eval. Numeric atol, rtol, eps_xyz and eps_eval remain unresolved blocking inputs. Repair must provide independently justified values and freeze them before fresh comparison; otherwise stop without agreement or dense-quality conclusions.
anchor.independent_code: Build standalone transform-reconstruction checker and independent DockQ-component checker on synthetic fixtures. Verify rigid transforms, identity model/native and deliberately displaced ligand. CPU/GPU agreement alone cannot validate shared bugs.

predictions.if_lever: At 54000 versus 3600 rotations, best50 DockQ rises over 0.01 beyond noise on all 4 cases; rank1 changes remain separate.
predictions.if_not: At 54000 versus 3600 rotations, at least 1 case lacks best50 DockQ gain over 0.01 beyond noise, or dense search misses budget.
predictions.noise_rule: Use 7 balanced timing blocks, scheduling seed 20261103, all 3 arms per case in randomized order after agreement passes. Record all endpoint ranges; deterministic repeats do not increase biological sample size. Seal evaluator error bound eps_eval on independent fixtures; use worst-case endpoint ranges above. Timing: paired block bootstrap, resample 7 blocks jointly across cases, 10000 draws, 95% interval. Exclude only predeclared instrumented diagnostics. No outcome-dependent reruns or tolerance relaxation.

calibration.title: Differential tracing of CPU/GPU numerical disagreement

phase.what: Later calibration allocation only: installation, tiny fixtures, memory/transfer/storage measurement and telemetry validation. Exercise all 6 stage injections and null controls. Include setup, retrieval and idle in 2-hour timer. No four-case study or native quality evaluation.

gate.else: Stop, retrieve and redesign offline; never extend calibration into full study.

phase.stop_rule: Projected allocation including shutdown < calibration_cap_usd; target <= calibration_target_usd. At timer expiry terminate and retain incomplete status. No dependent main work on calibration route. Require observed localized_faults >= 6 and zero false localizations before main spend; otherwise stop acquisition.

phase.what: Offline review of precision, FFT error propagation, voxel boundaries, ties, reconstruction/serialization and evaluator stability. Use independent fixtures and analysis; seal numeric production atol/rtol, coordinate and DockQ bounds, tie policy, repetitions and failure rules before fresh study comparisons.

gate.else: Diagnostic-only audit allowed; no scientific acceptance or dense-quality release.

phase.stop_rule: No tolerance derived from historical or fresh CPU/GPU maximum deltas. Tiny fixtures do not prove production error bounds. If independent justification fails, proceed only with explicitly diagnostic reporting; scientific agreement and dense-quality handoff remain blocked.

anchor.what: Exact integer grid correlations and 6 injected faults check checkpoint alignment; independent pose reconstruction checks output interpretation.
anchor.published_value: No published four-case numerical-equivalence threshold found; oracle is proposed independent code, not an executed anchor.
anchor.tolerance: Integer oracle has exact expected values. For tiny-grid FFT diagnostic fixtures require absolute score error <= fixture_error and unique-peak agreement; tied maxima compared as sets. This fixture threshold is a DESIGN screen, not a production scientific score tolerance. Recover every injected stage exactly and accept no false localization on null controls. Production score/pose/DockQ bounds require independent analysis in seal; stop scientific agreement if unavailable.
anchor.independent_code: Build oracle_integer.py using Python integers and explicit periodic indexing, independent of FFT libraries; represent complex values as integer pairs. Build pose_oracle.py with explicit rigid-transform algebra and separate parser. Verify impulse, translation, cancellation and tied-peak fixtures.

predictions.if_lever: At 16 executions, tracing still localizes all 6 injected faults and reproduces natural divergence stages across paired repeats.
predictions.if_not: At 16 executions, tracing localizes fewer than 6 injected faults or natural divergence stages change between repeats.
predictions.noise_rule: Run 8 initial instrumented executions, then 8 matched repeat executions: CPU/GPU pair per case in each pass. Compare within-backend traces first, then cross-backend. Record absolute, relative and ULP errors, nonfinite counts, complex layout and normalization. Hash equality diagnoses bitwise identity only. Report changed rank membership and ties separately; repeat variability beyond sealed bounds blocks agreement. No biological sample-size increase from repeats.

calibration.title: Agreement before interpreting acceleration or denser search

anchor.absent_reason: No independently checked anchor for these exact inputs, source pin and arithmetic is available in supplied prompt. Published FAQ reports small CPU/GPU differences but gives no case-specific error proof [faq]. Build independent high-precision grid-correlation and pose-reconstruction checks during calibration; require audited error bounds before issuing agreement verdict. If these cannot be established within calibration cap, stop unresolved. Reusing MEGADOCK decoygen alone is not independent validation.

predictions.if_lever: At 4 repeats, independent bounds support agreement for all 4 cases and 50 ranks; 2 repeats leave calibration unresolved.
predictions.if_not: At 4 repeats, agreement remains unresolved or fails, or 2 repeats already suffice; extra calibration buys no changed agreement decision.
predictions.noise_rule: Start with 2 independent process launches per backend per case; extend cumulatively to 4. Record every run and all pairwise same-backend discrepancies. Exact-repeat diagnostic requires byte equality of stable output/PDB manifests, excluding volatile logs. Scientific acceptance separately requires identical output grid metadata, ranked transform correspondence and score intervals justified by floating-point analysis plus independent reference calculations and observed same-backend variation. Derive score and coordinate tolerances from audited arithmetic and serialization precision; seal numeric values before fresh comparison. Do not infer cross-backend tolerance from same-backend determinism, FAQ anecdotes, old 0.14 maximum, ratio bands, or epsilon added to observed differences.

phase.what: Up to 3 allocated hours, inclusive setup/idle: independent evaluator smoke checks, standard CPU/GPU matched comparison on every case and all 50 poses. Measure complete evaluator walls; compare against sealed numerical gates before dense target scoring.

gate.else: If measured complete per-case evaluation exceeds fixed 60-second allowance, stop; publish revised caps in a new plan before new replication.

phase.stop_rule: Any transform, score, coordinate or DockQ gate failure stops scientific speed/quality claims. If evaluator timing invalidates sealed caps, stop and issue new version before new replication; never retroactively resize caps.

anchor.what: CPU and GPU standard poses agree; native self-comparison and independent DockQ checks validate evaluation before dense scoring.
anchor.published_value: Native self-score target 1, derived from DockQ formula with complete contacts and zero RMSDs [dockq].
anchor.tolerance: DESIGN, sealed before fresh comparisons: identical ranked rotation/translation identifiers and ranks for all 50 outputs; maximum absolute docking-score difference <=0.20. This conservative engineering threshold exceeds user-reported historical maximum 0.14, not a numerical-analysis guarantee. Coordinates after reconstruction: maximum absolute coordinate difference <=0.001 angstrom; DockQ absolute difference <=0.000001 for corresponding standard poses. Self-DockQ within 0.000001 of 1. Independent PINDER versus pinned standalone DockQ absolute difference <=0.005 after identical atom, residue and chain maps; fail closed if semantics cannot be reconciled. No widening after seeing failures.
anchor.independent_code: Pin standalone wallnerlab/DockQ version and source hash before launch; compare against pinned pinder.eval on all standard-arm retained poses [dockq_code, pinder].

predictions.if_lever: GPU standard accelerates workflows by at least 1.05; dense completes CPU-standard budgets and improves best50 DockQ by 0.01 on 3 cases.
predictions.if_not: GPU standard gains fall below 1.05, dense misses CPU-standard budgets, or best50 DockQ gains below 0.01 occur on 2 cases.
predictions.noise_rule: One untallied warmup per configuration; 7 randomized matched blocks, each configuration running all 4 cases serially. Use fixed randomization seed 20261103. Per block compute ratio of summed complete per-case walls; derive exact distribution-free median interval from ordered paired ratios (minimum, maximum): coverage 1-2/2^7=0.984375, conservatively >=95%. Report all per-case ratios too. Require deterministic transforms and DockQ agreement across repeated outputs within sealed tolerances; no pseudoreplication across cases. Trace separate reruns after uninstrumented timing; publish perturbation, not traced timing as primary.

calibration.title: Dense search changes candidate recovery and ranking differently

phase.what: First rental includes setup, retrieval, build and cleanup, charged once. Calibrate precision/scorer on independent bundled fixtures. Time one complete standard and one dense search on largest-grid selected case without native scoring; bound other cases from pinned FFT grids. Measure reconstruction/scoring overhead on independent fixtures. Count caps admitting all-case predicted workflows under 3 times measured timing plus measured overhead. No full four-case quality experiment on calibration route. Conservative total projection must also fit shared science_h allocation, including all agreement/search jobs, scorer repeats, setup and idle; otherwise no scientific launch. Independent scoring fixture, native-self and rigid-transform fixture are separate fixed inputs.

gate.else: Export calibration evidence and stop; no scientific rental or dense quality comparison.

phase.stop_rule: 2-hour allocation timer. Stop if projected calibration charge exceeds USD10 or is not strictly below USD20 including all allocation overhead. No native quality rerun merely to create measurement.

phase.what: Shared science rental: three standard CPU/GPU repeats on all four cases. Validate ordered transforms, rankings, scores and DockQ. Derive per-case noise envelopes using sealed formula; seal resulting envelopes before fresh dense evaluation.

gate.else: Stop scientific comparison; retain disagreement report and receipts.

phase.stop_rule: Stop on any anchor failure, DockQ difference>0.0001, score tolerance failure, independent scorer error>0.00001 or epsilon>0.005.

anchor.what: Reproduce independent DockQ example, then require matching CPU/GPU standard transforms, rankings and DockQ before dense quality evaluation. [dockq]
anchor.tolerance: DESIGN: documented example first-interface score within 0.0005 of printed 0.994; unrounded cross-scorer discrepancy<=0.00001 on identical mappings. Seal docking-score tolerance=max(0.000001,2*maximum independent-fixture CPU/GPU score difference), capped at 0.2, before selected-case agreement. Fresh standard requires identical ordered rotation/translation identifiers and DockQ endpoint differences<=0.0001. Failure stops comparison; no tuning to selected-case quality.
anchor.independent_code: Pin independent wallnerlab/DockQ commit and fixture bytes before launch. Run documented 1A2K example and native-self/rigid-transform checks. Compare PINDER and independent code with identical residue handling and fixed chain maps. PINDER evaluation documented at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinder-org/pinder/ebeb28a2f8411363cef722b7d293c978f7442672/README.md [pinder].

predictions.if_lever: At 54000 rotations, best50 DockQ gains exceed 0.01 and calibrated noise; rank1 may decline, within common complete-workflow budgets.
predictions.if_not: At 54000 rotations, best50 gains fail 0.01 or noise thresholds, or complete workflows exceed common budgets; rank1 remains separately reported.
predictions.noise_rule: DESIGN: independently validate scorer fixtures and precision before fresh quality. On three CPU/GPU standard repeats per case, seal endpoint epsilon=max(0.000001,2*standard-repeat range,10*independent-scorer discrepancy). Abort if epsilon>0.005 or independent scorer discrepancy>0.00001. Before dense evaluation seal these values. Then run three paired GPU standard/dense output repeats per case; rescore each saved output three times. Fresh within-arm endpoint range exceeding sealed epsilon invalidates case; never widen tolerance afterward. Report individual values and ranges, without population confidence intervals. Record seeds if implementation uses randomness.

calibration.title: CPU host scheduling as workflow affordability calibration

anchor.what: Reproduce frozen CPU docking records and every retained pose exactly; then verify separate serial units against fresh original execution.
anchor.tolerance: 0 differing scientific bytes, 0 missing or extra scientific files, identical stable relative paths. Exclude only predeclared volatile logs and timestamps.
anchor.independent_code: New manifest and byte-comparison verifier; no independent docking implementation claimed.

predictions.if_lever: Width 2 or 4 preserves outputs and achieves at least 1.05 speed factor in both repeats against nearby original serial blocks.
predictions.if_not: Widths 2 and 4 preserve outputs but fail the 1.05 speed-factor threshold in at least one repeat each.
predictions.noise_rule: Seal block order a,b,c2,c4,c4,c2,b,a before execution. Compare each concurrent repeat with bracketing original serial measurements. Report raw times, both factors, minimum and mean. Two repeats provide a screening rule, not statistical confidence. Discordant or failed repeats trigger a separately sealed serial variability control next; never lower threshold or append opportunistic repeats.
